players.product: SWEP brazed-plate heat exchangers for coolant distribution unit and chiller OEMs, plus liquid-cooling connectors and OPW couplers / cryogenic cooling infrastructure for data centers

quarterly_data.signal: Dover 10-K: 2025 revenue was $8,092,571 thousand versus $7,745,909 thousand in 2024 (up 4.5%), with gross profit margin of 39.8% versus 38.2%. Capital expenditures increased $52.7 million to $220.3 million in 2025 (from $167.5 million in 2024), primarily to support growth initiatives, productivity and new product launches; Dover plans average annual capital spending of approximately 2% of revenue, focused on internal projects designed to expand market participation and manufacturing capacity.

Dover 10-K segment data, 2025 versus 2024: Climate & Sustainability Technologies (equipment and components for the commercial refrigeration, heating and cooling and beverage can-making end-markets) revenue $1,559,841 thousand versus $1,579,649 thousand (down 1.3%), bookings $1,665,049 thousand versus $1,570,632 thousand (up 6.0%), segment margin 17.0%; Pumps & Process Solutions (end-markets include thermal management) revenue $2,148,670 thousand versus $1,894,566 thousand (up 13.4%), bookings $2,041,184 thousand (up 9.9%), segment margin 30.3%.
